metadata.description: Claude Code plugins for Godot 4 game development: fast verified feedback loop, review hub, game design analysis, art, UI and audio pipelines

plugins.name: godot-core
plugins.description: Fast, log-judged Godot checks for agents: import, parse, boot, tests, receipts and edit hooks

plugins.name: godot-assets
plugins.description: Project asset registry for Godot: immutable versions, review events, provenance and a folded status

plugins.name: game-design
plugins.description: Game design for Godot projects: decisions, canon and contracts as JSON records, progression graphs analyzed and simulated, combat balance models, sourced research and SVG charts for the review hub

plugins.name: godot-l10n
plugins.description: Localization for Godot: strings kept as records, built into PO files, checked for parity and leaks, translated in masked batches

plugins.name: godot-studio
plugins.description: Team orchestration for Godot: file-owned lanes in warm worktrees, ownership and frozen-test guards, a verified merge queue, decision records

plugins.name: godot-art
plugins.description: Game art for Godot: art bible and briefs, fal-media output registered with provenance, import, VRAM and GLB audits, readability and style judges
